evidence.detail: The class is hard-wired to configs/anims.yaml with compiled counterpart configs/a.bin.
It extends the generic config loader as rs.t.c<rs.d.a>; R28 identifies rs/d/a as SequenceDefinition.

Per-ID maps construct/clone SequenceDefinition objects and decode sequence-specific keys including animation/Maya fields; surviving diagnostics include "(ID {}) Unknown config: {}" and "Could not find clone ID {} for Anim {}".
SequenceDefinition loading invokes this loader, then replaces matching IDs in all active SequenceDefinition arrays with the parsed definitions.

proposals.note: SequenceDefinitionConfigLoader is the conservative semantic name for the exact anims.yaml/a.bin SequenceDefinition config loader. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: The class is hard-wired to configs/items.yaml with compiled counterpart configs/i.bin.
It extends the generic config loader as rs.t.c<rs.d.k>; R28 identifies rs/d/k as ItemDefinition.

Per-ID maps construct ItemDefinition objects and decode item-specific fields including name, actions/model data and texture/retexture controls such as fulltexture and textureinvanim; unknown keys use the surviving item-aware diagnostic "(ID {} '{}') Unknown config: {}".
ItemDefinition initialization creates and loads this config loader, and the normal ItemDefinition lookup path returns its configured definition for matching positive item IDs before archive decoding.

proposals.note: ItemDefinitionConfigLoader is the conservative semantic name for the exact items.yaml/i.bin ItemDefinition config loader. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
